findings.message: Off-by-one error in loop condition causes an index out of range panic. The loop iterates up to and including `start+len(pageRows)`, which accesses `rows[start+len(pageRows)]`. Since `pageRows` is a slice of length `len(pageRows)`, the valid indices are `start` through `start+len(pageRows)-1`. The final iteration attempts to access an index one past the end of the slice.
findings.suggestion: Change the loop condition from `i <= start+len(pageRows)` to `i < start+len(pageRows)`.
